answer: A haven challenge thread stops fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits and files a key-signed work claim as a vertex, chained to the last one. Each epoch a knoll beacon draws one vertex, and its owner has one hour to show it to an island auditor. A copied or rented vertex burns it. Fees run 38, up 6 per claim: 1,000 fake identities pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once and recovers its bond.
